summary.one_liner: A curated, link-only list of courses, books, podcasts, videos, blogs, conferences and tools for product managers to learn and grow.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" list rather than software. It opens with a short definition of the product manager role, then groups resources into sections: Courses (with subsections for soft skills, hard skills, frameworks, UI/UX, analytics, finance and marketing), Books, Podcasts, Video, Telegram channels, Websites and blogs, and Conferences. The Tools section is organized by purpose, including product management, customer journey mapping, mindmaps, wireframes, prototyping, hypothesis testing, web analytics, A/B testing, newsletters, calls, surveys, task tracking, notepads and customer support. Entries are mostly names with an author, provider or brand, and most do not include descriptions or links in the README. Many listed resources are in Russian or aimed at a Russian-speaking audience, and the list notes it is also available in Russian. Contributions are invited through a guidelines file.
use_cases: pick product management books to read
discover product manager podcasts and blogs
choose tools for wireframing and prototyping
find A/B testing and web analytics tools
notable: Broad coverage across courses, books, podcasts, video, Telegram channels, blogs and conferences in one list
Tools grouped by job-to-be-done, such as customer journey mapping, A/B testing and surveys
Includes Russian-language resources and a Russian version of the list
Lists recent AI-agent product management skill libraries alongside classic tools
caveats: Contains only names and links-by-name; the README gives little description of each entry
Many resources are Russian-language or regional, which may not suit every reader
Some entries are unrelated to product management, and the list does not indicate which are current
